model.name: HF strip dipole (14.2 MHz)
model.description: A center-fed half-wave dipole for the 20 m amateur band: a thin PEC strip of length L and width w in free space, with a lumped port across the center gap g. Lengths are in mm and frequencies in GHz, so f0 = 0.0142 is 14.2 MHz. The mesh is automatic, so L, w and g can be changed. The strip stands in for a wire: this is a working HF example, not a measured antenna.

notes.edge_rule: Thirds placement for this geometry without thin converted sheets
notes.air_cells_per_wavelength: 21 cells/λ in air from 24 feature cells/λ and 2 primitives
notes.pad: λ/4 at f min gives the NF2FF box clearance from the radiator and boundary
notes.dielectric_cells: No dielectric; this minimum is unused
